rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something main, most important, or most prevalent.

example.english: Rice is the dominant staple in this region.
example.traditional: 呢種米係呢個地區嘅主要糧食。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 mai5 hai6 ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 loeng4 sik6

rows.note: Use this when a party, government, or group is currently in power or ruling.

example.english: The dominant party in power says it will cut taxes.
example.traditional: 而家當權嗰個政黨話會減稅。
example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 dong1 kyun4 go2 go3 zing3 dong2 waa6 wui5 gaam2 seoi3

rows.note: Use this before a body-part noun such as 手 or 邊 for the preferred or more dexterous hand or side.

example.english: My dominant hand is too tired to lift a glass of water.
example.traditional: 我隻慣用手攰到拎唔起杯水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 gwaan3 jung6 sau2 gui6 dou3 ling1 m4 hei2 bui1 seoi2
